extraction: Unmodified arXiv LaTeX source tarball for Ibata et al. 2021, ApJ 914, 123, 'Charting the Galactic Acceleration Field I'. Read ONLY to establish the provenance of the VizieR table's Stream label column.
note: Establishes that the per-star 'Stream' label 1-32 in J/ApJ/914/123 has NO published name mapping: the paper says the label is used to colour the streams in a figure. Also confirms the paper's own per-stream counts (276 stars for the NGC 6397 stream, 388 for NGC 3201) used here to validate the derived label-to-name mapping. The orbits drawn in that paper's figures were integrated in the Dehnen & Binney (1998) potential model #1 -- those orbit curves are MODEL, not measurement.
